title: Their Budget Is Wrong Every Month of the Year
blurb: Marcus and Jen's budget is wrong every month of the year, and not because they overspend.

title: £80 More a Month Bought Her Three Days
blurb: Priya gave her eating-out budget £80 more a month and the money ran out three days later than before: the 23rd instead of the 20th.

title: £14.99 a Month for an App She Never Opened
blurb: On Leah's bank statement: a fitness app she has never opened, taking £14.99 a month since January.

title: Six Years of Tax Bills From Savings, Each One a Surprise
blurb: For six years Anita has paid her tax out of savings, twice a year, and been surprised both times: £66,600 in all.

title: How Much Emergency Fund? Every Answer Is Wrong (UK)
blurb: Six months of expenses is the standard emergency fund advice. On £150 a month spare that is 45 months — and only if nothing goes wrong in the meantime.
